title: Erdős 249 rank-one obstruction: geometric tails and uniform rung bounds

concepts.label: Möbius–Mersenne geometric envelope
concepts.note: For every rung r at least three, the absolute n-th ladder term is dominated by the geometric sequence (1/8)^n.

concepts.label: uniform finite-prefix control
concepts.note: Exact prefix-tail splitting together with a uniform error bound after four atoms.

concepts.label: strict rung upper bounds
concepts.note: Elementary product growth forces every rung r at least three below one, while the target rung two lies below 8/9.

concepts.label: rank-one obstruction boundary
concepts.note: These estimates support the landed strict-subrank no-go theorem; they do not prove irrationality of the totient series or exclude higher-rank constructions.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED GEOMETRIC ENVELOPE: if r is at least three, then 2^3 is at most 2^r, hence 2^(-r) is at most 1/8, and the absolute n-th Möbius–Mersenne term is bounded by (1/8)^n for every n.
statement_nodes.engine: Monotonicity of powers of two, inversion of a positive inequality, and the existing termwise Möbius–Mersenne geometric estimate.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Elementary geometric-series domination specialized to the repository's Möbius–Mersenne terms.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The majorant controls only absolute tail size. It supplies no cancellation, nonvanishing linear form, denominator growth, or irrationality conclusion.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED PREFIX PACKET: every Möbius–Mersenne rung is exactly its first Y atoms plus the tail after Y; when Y is at least four and r is at least three, the absolute difference between the full rung and that prefix is at most 1/3584.
statement_nodes.engine: Split the summable ladder at Y, dominate its shifted tail by the one-eighth geometric series, and evaluate the geometric sum at the worst permitted prefix length Y=4.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Standard absolutely convergent series splitting and geometric tail estimation, instantiated with exact constants.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The estimate is a uniform analytic input to the rank-one quotient obstruction. It does not show that any prefix is nonzero or produce an irrationality certificate.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED STRICT UPPER BOUND: for every r at least three, 3^r is strictly smaller than 2^r(2^r-1); combined with the two-atom decomposition and its tail bound, this forces the Möbius–Mersenne rung Θ_r to be strictly below one.
statement_nodes.engine: Induction for the exponential product inequality, followed by comparison of the explicit two-atom value and the certified absolute tail bound.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: Elementary exponential comparison and a project-specific consequence for the Möbius–Mersenne ladder.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The bound is one-sided and concerns rungs r≥3. It does not determine their signs, monotonicity, algebraic nature, or limit.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: PROVED TARGET-RUNG BOUND: the Möbius–Mersenne rung Θ_2 is strictly smaller than 8/9.
statement_nodes.engine: Use the exact first-five-atom decomposition at r=2 and its certified remainder bound, then discharge the resulting rational inequality.
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: A finite exact estimate for the repository's normalized target rung; no novelty claim is made.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: This is a numerical upper bound on Θ_2, not an irrationality or transcendence statement about Θ_2 or the original totient series.

intra_zone_relations.basis: The termwise one-eighth envelope is the quantitative input used to estimate the exact prefix-tail decomposition uniformly after four atoms.
The first node controls all source rungs r≥3 in the rank-one quotient, while the finite target estimate controls Θ_2 on the other side of the obstruction gap.
